Ian Talbert

I am a mechanical engineer passionate about the intersection of robotics and human experience. My life has been dedicated to robotics since middle school where I participated in competetive robotics, finding a joy in tinkering and making, finding new form in college combat robotics.

I currently work as a mechanical design engineer at VEX Robotics, working to spark inspiration and excitement in STEM for students around the world. I am most proud of my contributions to the VEX AIR drone project, which is an educational drone with full sensor suite, brushless powertrain, and autonomous capability.

My engineering practice is grounded in pragmatic manufacturing methods - the right strokes, for the right folks. I consider myself a subscriber to the idea of DFYM - Design for Your Manufacturing. As a high schooler with unprecedented access to a machine shop, I could meticulously machine parts I now design to be outsourced with minimal assembly time on my part.
